message.content:
Produce an executable closed-loop build plan for **SFCC-236 "Product Card Shared Component"** (Zimmermann PWA Kit, repo /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa). All evidence below is already gathered and verified — do not re-gather. Do not write code. Scope is SFCC-236 ONLY; SFCC-83 and SFCC-84 are deliberately held (blocked on data source + consent + surface list).

## Story
8 points, Sprint 4 (ends 7 Sep), epic SFCC-2, assignee Marcel, labels PRC-09/SPR-01/02/10/11/12/13/14/16, Squad-A.
It **blocks** SFCC-80, SFCC-90, SFCC-185, SFCC-497, SFCC-83, SFCC-84, SFCC-743, SFCC-778 — it is the keystone.
Description: one shared Product Card supporting multiple display variations via a style prop; "scoped to the visual and interactive layer only — product data is sourced from SFCC."

## Acceptance criteria (verbatim from customfield_10231)
**Core component:** (1) primary product image always displayed regardless of variation. (2) built as a PWA component — renders correctly on any page surface without page-specific logic embedded in the component.
**PLP variation:** default shows image, name, badge, price (incl. was/now), cart icon. Desktop hover → size selector becomes visible, price disappears, tile image switches item/flat → model. Desktop hover → arrows appear to click through product images. Mobile → size selector not displayed. Out of stock → cart greyed out, "notify me" link on hover instead of price.
**Home page variation:** default shows image and name. Desktop hover → arrows appear. Desktop hover → price (incl. was/now) appears. Mobile → only image and name.
**Wishlist variation:** default shows image, cart icon, name, colour, size, badge, price (incl. was/now). Remove ('x') CTA top right. Desktop hover → image switches to model photo. Desktop hover → arrows appear.
**Recently Viewed Full History variation (same behaviour as PLP card):** same five ACs as PLP.
**Variation extensibility:** a new style (e.g. Search) can be added without restructuring the base component.

## Figma — resolved and verified
File `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm` (Zimmermann_Design_System_2026).
Component set **`40000223:2822` `Product card / Product-card`**, 20 variants:
- `Size` = Desktop (288w) | Mobile (179w) | Hero (288w)
- `State` = Default | Hover
- `Type` = Home | PLP/PDP | Wishlist | `Defualt` (sic, Hero only)
- `Unavailable/coming soon` = False | True

Key variant node IDs: Desktop/Default — Home `40000214:6141`, PLP/PDP `40002163:41441`, Wishlist `40002187:58446`. Desktop/Hover — Home `40002163:36593`, PLP/PDP `40002163:41459`, Wishlist `40002187:58458`. Desktop/Default/Unavailable=True — Home `40002163:39981`, PLP/PDP `40002163:41450`, Wishlist `40002187:58452`. Desktop/Hover/Unavailable=True — `40002163:39990`, `40002163:41468`, `40002187:58464`. Mobile/Default — Home `40000223:2821`, PLP/PDP `40002163:41477`, Wishlist `40002187:58470`. Mobile/Default/Unavailable=True — `40002163:39999`, `40002163:41486`, `40002187:58473`.
Sub-part sets: `Image Group ` `40002742:46323` (Size=Large|Hero|5:4|Small) · `image` `40000301:4718` (Image=Photography|Product-shot) · `Card heading` `40002109:25294` (Type=Default|Message) · `Card-content` `40002109:26908` (Size=Desktop `40002109:26906` | Mobile `40002163:37103`) · `Slide indicator` `40002536:7957` (Qty images=5|8, Slide selected=1..N, 13 variants) · `Size Selector` `40003066:34868` (Type=Default|One Size) · `.base-size-selector` `40003038:125876` (State=Default|Selected|Focus|Disabled) · `atom/add-to-wishlist` `40000214:6159` (State=Default|Selected).

Verified internal structure of `Card-content Size=Desktop` (`40002109:26906`):
`Content(40,32,208x138) > Frame(208x82) > [Product name and attributes(208x49) > [Product name and icons(208x25) > [Card heading instance 176x25, Icons(184,0,24x24) > touchContainer(24x24) > Icon_bag instance(4,4,16x16)], Attributes(0,41,208x8) > [Colour text 53x8, Size text 43x8]], Price text(0,73,208x9), Size Selector instance(0,106,208x28, hidden=true)], Link instance(0,114,57x24)`.

**Hover is an expand, not a restyle** — heights grow: Home 489→522, PLP/PDP 522→541, Wishlist 546→565; Home with Unavailable=True 489→570.

## Findings that MUST shape the plan

1. **`overrides/app/components/product-tile/` DOES NOT EXIST.** Neither does `CardBaseline` — it appears only as prose in `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` lines 128/181/186. Nothing to extend.
2. **DO NOT create `overrides/app/components/product-tile/`.** The overrides resolver would silently redirect PLP, Search, Home, Cart, PDP and empty-search-results to it. `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-list/index.jsx:51-53` does `import ProductTile, {Skeleton as ProductTileSkeleton}` — an override without a named `Skeleton` export **breaks PLP at import time**. Build in `ui-kits/` instead; blast radius is then only explicit importers.
3. **The recipe key cannot be `ProductTile`** — `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts:357` fails any recipe shadowing a base SFCC recipe name. Use a `Zimm`-prefixed key.
4. **Reuse these existing registered atoms** rather than rebuilding: `zimmProductName`, `zimmProductPrice`, `zimmProductDescription`, `zimmColourSwatch`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup`, `zimmButton`, `zimmIcon`. All under `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/`.
5. **Pattern to match: PR #64** (SFCC-89) — 5 atoms + 2 molecules, four-file set each (`index.tsx`, `index.stories.tsx`, `index.test.tsx`, `<name>.css.ts`), recipe registered in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`.
6. **Exemplar to copy precisely: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/`.** Named export (PascalCase) always; default export only if a consumer needs `React.lazy`. Props type declared inline at top, named `<Component>Props`, not exported; exported data types go alongside. Recipe key is a module-level const, consumed via `useMultiStyleConfig(KEY, props)`. Parts applied with `<chakra.div __css={styles.x}>` — `__css`, not `sx`, and `chakra.*` primitives not `Box`/`Flex`. i18n via `defineMessages` at module scope + `useIntl()`.
7. **Recipe rules:** `<name>.css.ts` exports a named const matching the recipe key exactly, with `parts: [...]` and a `baseStyle` function of the props. Values must be `var(--zimm-*)` custom properties — **bare Chakra token keys fail `recipeGuards.test.ts`**. Responsive steps are **explicit media queries keyed off a `BP` const**, never Chakra's array shorthand (the guard walks arrays and fails every element). `recipeParts.test.ts` fails if any `styles.X` read in `index.tsx` is missing from `parts`.
8. **Tests:** Vitest + RTL. Mock `useMultiStyleConfig` to return a flat parts object. Mock the icons barrel (`vi.mock('.../zimmIcon')`) — it has a Vitest SVG side-effect failure. **`useIntl` throws without a provider** — wrap renders in `IntlProvider` + `MemoryRouter`.
9. **No data fetching inside `overrides/app/components/`** — the card receives everything as props. `useIntl`/`useUiCopy` are the only permitted exceptions.
10. **Interactions are OUT of scope.** Add-to-bag and size-selection behaviour belong to SFCC-185 (PLP Quick Add), SFCC-497 (Wishlist Add to Bag), SFCC-90 (Homepage) — confirmed by the reporter in Jira comment 13812. The card renders the controls; the wiring lands elsewhere. Design for that: controls should be render-slot / callback-prop driven.
11. **Page wiring is OUT of scope.** PLP, Cart and Wishlist have no page override at all (base-only) and base Wishlist renders `ProductItem`, a row. Do not plan page ports.

## Verified requirement corrections (do not re-litigate)
- **It is a BAG icon, not a wishlist star.** Verified in Figma (`Icon_bag`); `atom/add-to-wishlist` is not placed in any card variant. SPR-14/SPR-15 were amended wishlist→cart. CRM-113–119 still says star but is stale.
- **SPR-05 (model/item view toggle) is struck through** — descoped, do not implement.
- **SPR-16 reads "~~clickable~~ product badges"** — badges are display-only, not clickable.
- **SPR-11:** each colour variant renders as a separate tile.
- **PRC-09/17/18:** the price slot needs three states plus precedence — list, sale (Was/Now), and customer-group/VIC, where "customer group discounts prevail over sale pricing". Treat VIC as a flagged assumption (ties to SFCC-778, currently blocked by this story).

## Assumptions to state explicitly in the plan
- "Recently Viewed Full History" variation = Figma `Type=PLP/PDP` (the AC says "same behavior as PLP card"). No fifth variant designed or built.
- `Hero` size / `Type=Defualt` is out of scope — no AC covers it, and its two variants have byte-identical names (a Figma variant conflict).
- **No Tablet card variant exists.** Artboards are 402 / 768 / 1440; 769–1439 is unspecified and Chakra's `md` is 768. The plan must state which side of 768 the mobile/desktop variants serve.
- The AC says hover reveals **arrows** to page through images; Figma ships `Slide indicator`, a dot/bar indicator, not arrows. Flag; do not silently pick one.
- Badge rendering: `.docs/prd/plp.md:71` says badges are not yet in PLP designs, and TSD-SFCC-225 delivers `c_productBadges` only on the product **GET** hook — PLP/search grids come from product *search*, so the attribute will not be in tile data. Treat the badge slot as present-but-unfed.
- No loading state and no empty state exist in the Figma set.

## Tier / ownership constraints
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/**` — CODEOWNERS: `pwa-squad-a` + `pwa-squad-b`, no approver teams.
- `overrides/app/components/**/*.css.ts` — squads only (last-match-wins rule).
- **`overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` is Tier 2, UI-Designer + tier-2 + tier-1 approvers — unavoidable, every new recipe registers there.** Flag it as the one Tier 2 touch.
- Do NOT touch `overrides/app/theme/foundation/**` or `theme/index.ts` (Tier 1). If a value has no existing `--zimm-*` token, say so and leave it — do not invent one.
- AGENTS.md Hard Rule #10: crossing protection tiers needs scope confirmation.

## House rules
TypeScript only under `overrides/`. Australian spelling in Zimmermann-authored identifiers. `textStyle` for type, never raw `fontSize`. Storybook story required, `title: 'Commerce/...'`, mandatory `Default` export. `npx tsc --noEmit` must pass. WCAG 2.2 AA (note: Figma's `touchContainer` is exactly 24×24 — meets SC 2.5.8 with zero margin).

## Deliverable
Goal statement · scale call (multi-commit or multi-branch, with reasoning — note the branch must be cut fresh from `develop`; the current checked-out branch is a merged SFCC-91 branch) · file manifest with tier and owner per file · sequenced steps each with concrete, checkable pass criteria · per-step loop configuration · open questions. Be specific about component decomposition: which atoms/molecules, and whether the variation axis is a config prop or a discriminated union (note the Wishlist type needs printed colour+size and a remove CTA that the others don't).

content.text: I have what I need. Here is the plan. --- # SFCC-236 — Product Card Shared Component: Build Plan ## 1. Goal statement Build the shared Zimmermann Product Card as prescribed by **SFCC-236** (8 pts, Sprint 4, epic SFCC-2, Squad A), as designed in Figma **`wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm` component set `40000223:2822` "Product card / Product-card"** (20 variants across Size × State × Type × Unavailable), as approached by the FED handbook's ui-kits atomic layering and one-canonical-styling-surface rules, and as established by **PR #64 (SFCC-89)** and the exemplar `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/` — a named-export component reading a `Zimm*`-namespaced multipart recipe via `useMultiStyleConfig`, parts applied with ``, all values as `var(--zimm-*)` custom properties with explicit media queries. The card is the **visual and interactive layer only**: it takes every value as a prop, owns no data fetching, and renders the add-to-bag / size-selection controls without wiring their behaviour (that lands in SFCC-185, SFCC-497, SFCC-90). --- ## 2. Scale call ### Single branch, seven commits, one PR. Cut fresh from `develop` — the current checkout `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection` is a merged branch and must not be built on: ``` git fetch origin && git checkout -b feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component origin/develop ``` **Why one branch, despite ~24 files (over the "< ~10 files" heuristic):** file count is the wrong measure here. This is one component family, one Figma component set, one ticket, one reviewer set (`pwa-squad-a` + `pwa-squad-b` on every file). The molecules are not independently shippable — `zimmProductCardMedia` and `zimmProductCardContent` have exactly one consumer, the organism, so merging them separately merges dead code. Splitting would also multiply the single Tier 2 touch (`theme/components/index.ts`) across three PRs and three tier-2/tier-1 approval cycles for what is an append-only registry edit. **Why not multiple branches for the Tier 2 file:** the registry addition is six two-line additions to `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`. Every new recipe in this codebase goes there; isolating it into its own PR would leave the first PR's components resolving to no recipe at all. Keep it in-branch, flag it loudly in the PR body. ### How much loop this warrants — and what I am deliberately dropping This gets the **full build loop** (Implementer → Tester → Scorer per step). It is a keystone: eight tickets are blocked on it (SFCC-80, 90, 185, 497, 83, 84, 743, 778), so a wrong prop contract propagates into eight downstream stories. That justifies per-step gating rather than a single end-of-branch review. Dropped deliberately, with reasons: | Dropped | Why | |---|---| | **Copy-first** (AGENTS.md workflow step 3) | Not applicable. No file exists at a mirrored path — `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-tile/` is not being overridden (see §3 note). There is nothing to copy, convert, and prove renders. | | **Playwright / `.feature` / `qa-generate`** | No page renders this component on this branch. There is no URL to navigate to. E2E belongs to SFCC-80 (PLP), SFCC-90 (Home), SFCC-497 (Wishlist). | | **Bundle-size / LCP step** | Nothing imports the card yet, so the bundle delta on every existing page is zero. Perf becomes real at SFCC-80. | | **Visual-regression** | Chromatic/Loki is out of budget in this repo (testing.md explicitly excludes it). Hover fidelity is a named manual Storybook check instead. | | **Multi-region fixture matrix** | The card takes pre-formatted strings; it has no locale/currency logic to vary. | Retained and non-negotiable: `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run test` (which runs `recipeGuards.test.ts` and `recipeParts.test.ts`), `npm run lint`, `npm run audit:tokens`, and `cr review --light --base develop` before the final commit. --- ## 3. File manifest Tier from `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` and `protectedFiles.md`, owner from `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/CODEOWNERS`. ### Modified | File | Tier | Owner (CODEOWNERS) | |---|---|---| | `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` | **Tier 2** | `@ZimmermannAU/tier-2-approvers` + `@ZimmermannAU/tier-1-approvers` (CODEOWNERS:117) | | `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx` | Tier 3/4 | `pwa-squad-a` + `pwa-squad-b` (CODEOWNERS:176) | | `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.test.tsx` | Tier 3/4 | same | **The Tier 2 file is the one and only tier crossing.** Per AGENTS.md Hard Rule #10 this needs explicit developer scope confirmation before Step 1 — see Pre-flight below. No Tier 1 file is touched; `theme/foundation/**` and `theme/index.ts` are read-only inputs. ### Created — all Tier 3/4, owner `pwa-squad-a` + `pwa-squad-b` Root: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/` ``` molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/ index.tsx · index.stories.tsx · index.test.tsx · zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts atoms/zimmSizeSelectorOption/ index.tsx · index.stories.tsx · index.test.tsx · zimmSizeSelectorOption.css.ts molecules/zimmSizeSelector/ index.tsx · index.stories.tsx · index.test.tsx · zimmSizeSelector.css.ts molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/ index.tsx · index.stories.tsx · index.test.tsx · zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts molecules/zimmProductCardContent/ index.tsx · index.stories.tsx · index.test.tsx · zimmProductCardContent.css.ts organisms/zimmProductCard/ index.tsx · index.stories.tsx · index.test.tsx · zimmProductCard.css.ts zimmProductCardShared.ts ``` 21 new + 3 modified = 24. **Explicitly NOT created: `overrides/app/components/product-tile/`.** Creating it activates the `ccExtensibility` resolver for PLP, Search, Home, Cart, PDP and empty-search-results, and `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-list/index.jsx:51-53` does `import ProductTile, {Skeleton as ProductTileSkeleton}` — an override without a named `Skeleton` export breaks PLP at import time. Building under `ui-kits/` keeps blast radius to explicit importers only (there are none yet). **`zimmProductCardShared.ts` is co-located, not in `theme/components/`.** It holds DOM-contract constants (the `data-card-slot` attribute names the organism's recipe selects on and the media molecule stamps) plus a `CARD_BP` object derived from `theme/foundation/gridSystem`'s `breakpoints`. It holds no design values, so `overrideStyling.md`'s "cross-file shared values go in `theme/components/`" does not bite; precedent is the co-located `zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`. This keeps the Tier 2 surface at exactly one file. Note it is `.ts`, not `.css.ts`, so CODEOWNERS matches it via `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/` — squads only, same result. --- ## Architecture decisions the steps assume **Variation axis = discriminated union for the data contract + a declarative config table for the layout.** `typescript.md` mandates the union ("model it as a discriminated union with a common literal `kind`/`type` field rather than one type with a pile of optional fields"), and it is required by the shape of the ACs: Wishlist alone needs printed `colour` + `size` + a mandatory `onRemove`; PLP alone needs `sizes` + `onNotifyMe`. A flat optional-everything prop bag lets you build a Wishlist card with no remove CTA (AC violation) and a PLP card with one (design violation). ``` ZimmProductCardProps = ZimmProductCardBaseProps & (PlpVariation | HomeVariation | WishlistVariation) base: id, href, name, headingLevel, primaryImage, hoverImage?, images?, currentPrice?, originalPrice?, isUnavailable?, badge? 'plp': sizes?, selectedSize?, onSizeSelect?, onAddToBag?, onNotifyMe? 'home': — (no additions) 'wishlist': colour, size, onRemove (required), onAddToBag? ``` `'recently-viewed'` is **not** a fourth member — per the AC it is behaviourally identical to PLP; consumers pass `variation: 'plp'`. Recorded as an assumption, not a silent choice. The render body must **not** `switch` on `props.variation`. Layout behaviour comes from a module-level `VARIATION_CONFIG` record (`showBag`, `showAttributes`, `showRemove`, `hoverHidesPrice`, `hoverRevealsPrice`, `hoverRevealsSizeSelector`, `hoverSwapsImage`). That is the mechanism satisfying "a new style (e.g. Search) can be added without restructuring the base component": add a union member + a config row, touch no JSX. **The card is fluid, not 288px.** `theme/foundation/gridSystem.ts` has `maxWidth: 'none'`, `columns: {base:4, md:8, xl:10}`, `columnGap: '1px'`. The Figma 288w/179w are widths at the reference artboards, not fixed values. The card fills its grid cell (`width: 100%`); the image area holds the ratio via `aspectRatio`. Grid placement belongs to SFCC-80. **Mobile/desktop boundary = `breakpoints.md` (48em / 768px), desktop from 768 up.** It is the only confirmed foundation breakpoint between the 402 and 1440 artboards, the grid already changes 4→8 columns there, and `min-width` is inclusive so the 768 artboard is served by the desktop card. Every hover rule is additionally gated on `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` so a 768px touch tablet never gets hover-only content. See OQ-5. **Hover is CSS-only, keyed on `:hover, :focus-within`.** No React hover state — 60 tiles re-rendering on pointer move is a PLP perf defect. `:focus-within` is not optional: WCAG 2.2 AA requires the revealed size selector and arrows be keyboard-reachable. Reveal selectors live in **one place** — the organism's `zimmProductCard.css.ts` root part, selecting descendants by the `data-card-slot` constants. Molecules stay hover-agnostic. **One link per card (stretched-link pattern).** The card contains a bag button, arrows, size options and (wishlist) a remove button — nesting those inside an `` is invalid HTML and an a11y failure. The `` wraps the product name only and carries a `::after { position:absolute; inset:0 }` overlay; every control gets `position:relative; z-index:1`. `href` arrives already site-prefixed from the page (no `useNavigation` in a leaf). Import precedent: `import { Link as RouteLink } from 'react-router-dom'` as in `atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx` — there is no `overrides/app/components/link/` override in this repo, contrary to a claim in `overrideStyling.md`. **Reuse, do not rebuild:** `ZimmProductName` (name + `as` heading level), `ZimmProductPrice` (Was/Now, PRC-09), `ZimmIcon` (`bag`, `close`, `chevron-left`, `chevron-right` all exist in `ICON_MAP`). No new icons. **VIC / customer-group pricing is not a card concern.** "Customer group discounts prevail over sale pricing" is a precedence rule for whoever computes the price string; the card renders `currentPrice`/`originalPrice` as given. Deferred to SFCC-778 (OQ-6). --- ## Pre-flight (not a commit) 1. Confirm with the developer, per Hard Rule #10, that touching Tier 2 `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` alongside Tier 3/4 ui-kits files is in scope for this PR. 2. `git branch --show-current` must return the new `feature/SFCC-236_*` branch cut from `origin/develop`, not the SFCC-91 branch. 3. Note `.docs/memory/sprintScope.md` records Sprint 4 as 10–21 Aug, which contradicts the real Sprint 4 (ends 7 Sep). Stale doc; non-blocking for Hard Rule #14 since nothing here depends on a later-sprint component. 4. Answer OQ-1 and OQ-3 (they gate Steps 1/4 and Step 2 respectively). --- ## 4. Steps Each step = one commit. Conventional-commit subject, `(SFCC-236)` suffix (enforced by `scripts/hooks/commit-msg`). Every step's baseline pass criteria, applied to all seven and not repeated below: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean · `npm run lint` clean · `npm run test` green (includes `recipeGuards.test.ts` and `ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts`) · `npm run audit:tokens` produces no new finding attributable to this step · no raw hex/px/rem/em in any created file except a commented, `provisional`-tagged exception · no bare Chakra token key anywhere, JSX props included · Australian spelling in Zimmermann-authored identifiers (`colour`, never `color`, in the wishlist attribute prop). --- ### Step 1 — `ZimmSlideIndicator` molecule **Skill:** `/new-component` Figma `Slide indicator 40002536:7957` (Qty images 5|8, Slide selected 1..N). Display-only dot/bar strip. Props: `count: number`, `activeIndex: number`. Renders `count` indicator elements, the active one styled distinctly. Recipe `ZimmSlideIndicator` with parts `['root','dot']`, `baseStyle` a function of `{ isActive }`. Registered in `theme/components/index.ts`. Story `Elements/ZimmSlideIndicator` with `Default`, `FiveImages`, `EightImages`, `LastSelected`. **Pass criteria** - Renders exactly `count` indicator nodes; exactly one carries the active treatment for any `activeIndex` in `[0, count-1]`. - `activeIndex` outside range clamps rather than throwing; `count <= 1` renders nothing (nothing to indicate). - Not in the tab order and not announced: root is `aria-hidden="true"` — it mirrors state announced elsewhere (the arrow buttons' labels), so exposing it duplicates. - `parts` array exactly equals the set of `styles.*` reads in `index.tsx` (`recipeParts.test.ts` is the gate). - `ZimmSlideIndicator` appears in the `components` export object in `theme/components/index.ts`. --- ### Step 2 — `ZimmSizeSelectorOption` atom + `ZimmSizeSelector` molecule **Skill:** `/new-component` **Blocked on OQ-3.** Mirrors the `zimmColourSwatch` / `zimmColourSwatchGroup` pair exactly. Option: Figma `.base-size-selector 40003038:125876` (State = Default | Selected | Focus | Disabled). Group: Figma `Size Selector 40003066:34868` (Type = Default | One Size). Option props: `value`, `label`, `isSelected`, `isDisabled`, `onSelect`. Renders a native `
